title: Praxis with a single Frobenius weight family at odd degree 3393 and ring degree 64
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5601 MiB (5.4696 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 1035306 million field multiplications (14356 and 1020951), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, n) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
